description: With a calibrated table, the first header of a transmission carrying data to an Ed4 peer holds our SENDER-APPROACH: variable speed, mixed strategy, EOW 12 not needed.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED (A-0041, A-0047). At 1500, during a burst, it sends S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0, SAP 5, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0, so TTD 1500 + 1296000000 ms, no confirmation): no SIS output (A-0095), dts.ttd starts (C-1050). At 2000 the burst's one block holds PADDING D_PDUs (type 14) to 0.0.1.2, EOT 10, each carrying one EOW; the PADDING itself is ignored (C-0588). A CAPABILITY with the Ed4 bit records its sender Ed4 (interp C-1261). Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 7000 LBT rule 1 (K-0067, K-0068), seed 0 slot 15, CONT_WAIT 45000 (K-0080). The transmit queue empties, so dts.ttd is cancelled (C-1050). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150; per rung the block bytes and ms given in the config (test data). The DATA C_PDU holds the DATA S_PDU SAP 5 to SAP 5 with its TTD; each type 7 has address size 3, and its EOT and reception window are the half seconds from the start of its block to the end of the burst, rounded up (C-0104, C-0350, C-1043). drc.table (corpus-format.md 6.1): ladder WN 2 Long, WN 4 Long, WN 4 Short, WN 6 Long (positions 0 to 3); no thresholds, so this node makes no recommendation of its own (corpus-format.md 6.2); sender constants tx_step_down_waits 2, tx_ceiling_initial 2, tx_ceiling_cap 4. 0.0.1.3 sends only CAPABILITY, so no recommendation has come and the transmission goes at drc.default_speed, WN 2 Long. The type 7 to 0.0.1.3 carries data to it, so its header takes SENDER-APPROACH, EOW 0xB04: bits 7-4 zero (C-0483), EOW 12 Needed 0 since our modem reports the received waveform (C-0481, C-0482), strategy 10 mixed, Fixed 0 (C-1018; open question 8, interp C-1286), placed after any owed EOW and the top-priority recommendations, of which there are none (interp C-1260). The rotation set is empty, so the 20 PADDING D_PDUs that fill the 256-byte block (11 bytes each) carry CAPABILITY (C-0426, C-1154).
